style.name: Bohemian
style.description: Contemporary bohemian styling combines warm colors, tactile materials, and an eclectic sense of collection. Handmade details and organic shapes can communicate informality without requiring a fixed visual formula.

fonts.heading: Cormorant Garamond
fonts.rationale: A warm serif sets an informal editorial mood while straightforward body text balances the texture and ornament.
